texts.title: Zeynep and Her Mother
texts.body:
Zeynep is nine years old. She lives in Konya with her family. She has a little brother, Ali, and a white cat, Pamuk.

Every Saturday morning, Zeynep goes to the market with her mother. The market is near their house. They walk there. Her mother always takes a big bag. “We do not need plastic bags,” she says.

At the market, they buy apples, tomatoes and bread. Zeynep carries the bread. Her mother pays for the food.

Last Saturday, it rained a lot. Zeynep and her mother did not go to the market. They stayed at home and made soup together. Pamuk slept on a chair. “I love rain!” Zeynep said.

texts.title: Story Week at Green Hill School
texts.body:
STORY WEEK
Green Hill School

Come and listen to stories in English!

Monday: Yunus Emre
Tuesday: Prophet Adam
Wednesday: Prophet Abraham
Thursday: Prophet Moses
Friday: Zero Waste

Time: 12:30 to 1:00
Place: Room 4, first floor
For: students in Grades 2, 3 and 4
It is free!

Please bring your English book.
No food or drinks in Room 4, please.
